lamps.steady: Brake fluid low or parking brake engaged. Have inspected if it stays lit.

lamps.lamp: High Engine Coolant Temperature Warning Light
lamps.steady: Engine is overheating. Stop in a safe place and shut off engine immediately.
lamps.flashing: Engine is running hot. Stop vehicle safely to prevent engine damage.

lamps.steady: Problem in airbag or seat belt pretensioner system. Have inspected by authorized workshop.
lamps.flashing: Blinks briefly on startup for self-check. Have inspected if blinking behavior is abnormal.

lamps.steady: Fuel level is low. Refuel as soon as possible.
Problem with ABS. Stop safely, restart engine, and consult workshop if light stays on.
System warning or message shown on display. Refer to information display.
lamps.flashing: Key fob not detected or warning condition active. Place key fob inside vehicle.

lamps.steady: Problem with emission control system. Have vehicle serviced at an authorized workshop.
lamps.flashing: Damage in emission control system. Have vehicle serviced at an authorized workshop.

lamps.steady: Problem with electric power steering system. Consult an authorized workshop.
Low engine oil pressure. Stop safely and check oil level immediately.
Malfunction in battery charging system. Have vehicle inspected by an authorized workshop.

lamps.lamp: Immobilizer/Keyless Push Start System Warning Light
lamps.steady: Problem with immobilizer or keyless push start system. Have system inspected.
lamps.flashing: Key/remote controller not recognized or system issue. Turn ignition off and on again.

lamps.steady: One or more doors are not completely closed. Close all doors before driving.
Depress brake pedal for Auto Gear Shift operation.
Problem with Auto Gear Shift system. Stop safely and contact authorized workshop.
lamps.flashing: Clutch temperature too high or system fault. Stop safely and allow system to cool.

lamps.steady: High beam assist system problem or temporarily stopped. Have system inspected if persistent.
Security system is operating or armed.
Turn signal or hazard lights operating.
lamps.flashing: Flashes when turn signal or hazard lights are active.

lamps.steady: Headlight high beams are turned on.
Side lights, position lights, or headlights are turned on.
Front fog lights are switched on.
ESP system is turned off or deactivated.
Malfunction in ESP system (other than ABS). Have inspected at authorized workshop.
lamps.flashing: Stability or traction control system actively engaged. Drive carefully.

lamps.steady: Engine has automatically stopped via ENG A-STOP system.
ENG A-STOP system is turned off manually.
lamps.flashing: System problem, lithium battery fault, or lead-acid battery replacement due. Have inspected immediately.

lamps.steady: Engine coolant temperature is low. Warm up engine before driving hard.

lamps.lamp: Dual Sensor Brake Support II OFF Indicator Light
lamps.steady: DSBS II system turned off or system malfunction. Have inspected by authorized workshop.
Adaptive cruise control system status or warning. Refer to information display.
Lane departure prevention system status or warning. Refer to information display.

lamps.lamp: Lane Departure Prevention OFF Indicator Light
lamps.steady: Lane departure prevention system is turned off.
Lane keep assist system status or warning. Refer to information display.
Steering assist system is active or operating.
One or more tyres significantly under-inflated. Stop safely and inflate tyres to proper pressure.
lamps.flashing: TPMS malfunction detected. Have vehicle inspected by an authorized workshop.

lamps.steady: Non-recoverable failure in wireless charger. Contact an authorized workshop.
lamps.flashing: Foreign object present, phone misaligned, or temperature too high. Remove object or allow to cool.

lamps.steady: Steering lock remains engaged. Press engine switch while turning steering wheel left or right.
